description_en: Edits the information of an existing 5G message signature
description_zh: 编辑已有的5G消息签名信息
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi update-rcs-signature --sign-name '阿里云' --logo China_regions0000/aliyun_logo_1750000.png --service-phone 400-800-0000 --service-email service@example.com --service-website https://www.example.com --service-terms https://www.example.com/terms --office-address No.XX,_XX_Road,_Xihu_District,_Hangzhou --bubble-color '#FF0000' --background-image China_regions0000/background_1750000.png --category 1 --description Aliyun_official_Chatbot --longitude 120.000 --latitude 30.000 --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateRCSSignature

parameters.help_en: The signature name. The signature name cannot be modified and is used only to identify the 5G signature to be edited. The value must be an existing available text message signature
parameters.help_zh: 签名名称。签名名称不可修改，仅用于定位需要编辑的5G签名。需为已存在的可用文本短信签名，
parameters.name: sign_name

parameters.help_en:
The fileKey of the logo image.

Call the [GetOSSInfoForUploadFile](~~GetOSSInfoForUploadFile~~) operation to obtain OSS configuration information. Set the BusinessType parameter to fcMediasms, upload the image to OSS, and then obtain the fileKey. For more information, refer to Upload files through OSS (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/sms/upload-files-through-oss).

The logo image must not exceed 50 KB in size and must be 400 × 400 pixels
parameters.help_zh:
Logo图片的fileKey。

调用[GetOSSInfoForUploadFile](~~GetOSSInfoForUploadFile~~)接口获取OSS配置信息，入参BusinessType传入fcMediasms，将图片上传至OSS后获取fileKey。具体操作，请参见通过OSS上传文件 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/sms/upload-files-through-oss)。

Logo图片大小不超过50KB，尺寸为400乘以400像素
parameters.name: logo
